description: A PHP script for testing the creation of test projects via XML-RPC API in the TestLink open source test management system. It includes multiple test cases with different options and parameters, utilizing external utility and sample files, and making calls to the IXR_Client class.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class for making XML-RPC client requests, instantiated with server URL and used to send test requests.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample message related to the API database.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test by sending an XML-RPC request using the IXR_Client.
